quarterly_data.quarter: Simulations Plus press release: Simulations Plus to Be Acquired by Altaris For (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Simulations Plus entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by affiliates of Altaris, LLC, a healthcare-focused investment firm, in an all-cash transaction; at or about closing Altaris anticipates combining the company with Chemical Computing Group (CCG), an existing Altaris portfolio company that provides advanced molecular design software to pharmaceutical, chemical and materials customers. The transaction is currently expected to close in the calendar fourth quarter of 2026, after which Simulations Plus becomes a privately held Altaris subsidiary and its stock will no longer trade on Nasdaq; headquarters expected to remain in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina. CEO Shawn O'Connor: the life sciences industry is at an inflection point as software and services rapidly evolve toward integrated, AI-driven platforms, cloud-based infrastructure and more predictable, subscription-based business models, and he believes the transaction will better position the company to serve customers and accelerate innovation.
quarterly_data.figure: no specific figure (expected close calendar Q4 2026)
